name: omp-plan-protection

author: stgmt

scripts.check: node --check src/plan-protection.ts && node --check dist/extension.js && node --check scripts/install-all-profiles.mjs && node --check scripts/uninstall-all-profiles.mjs && node --check scripts/e2e-programmer.mjs && node --check scripts/e2e-advisor-contract.mjs && node --check scripts/e2e-advisor-live.mjs
